listing.name: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate (ssbu-arena)
listing.summary: An independently maintained OpenSmash fork for competitive Super Smash Bros. Ultimate 1v1, using AArch64-to-C translation and a Windows Vulkan player with its own relay/rollback. Network-impairment and rollback tests used two windows on one PC; ranked play, Elo and replays are planned. The README describes local source installation and says no prebuilt player, but the reviewed v0.2.7 release includes SSBU-Arena.exe, a player ZIP and manifest; that discrepancy remains. Windows 10/11 x64 is primary. Linux/macOS guide links do not establish exact CPU or gameplay support. Use your own 13.0.4 or 13.0.5 dump, keys and owned updates/DLC. Separate firmware requirements are unclear. Portcove offers no setup or launch integration and has not tested gameplay.
